title: US 80 Dallas photos
text:
In July 2024 TxDOT awarded a $581 million contract to rebuild US 80 from Town East Blvd to east of Belt Line, including complete replacement of the I-635 interchange. See the US 80 archive page for views of the original freeway and interchange in this section.

These photos start east of I-30 and proceed eastward to Forney.

images.caption: Looking east from the Big Town road overpass

This next photo is fives miles east, looking west, west of Collins. Construction is in progress in 2026 in this five-mile gap between photos. The construction zone starts just ahead, before Belt Line. See the archive page for photos of the original freeway in this section.
Looking west from the FM 740 (Pinson Road) overpass in Forney
A miniature Statue of Liberty replica along the highway in Forney
